emojis.label: oil price drops to pre-war levels
emojis.title: Oil price falls back to pre-Iran war levels
emojis.summary: Signs that traffic through the key Strait of Hormuz shipping route is gradually resuming has helped to push the oil price down.

emojis.label: france's first ebola case confirmed
emojis.title: France Identifies Its First Case of Ebola
emojis.summary: A doctor who had traveled to the Democratic Republic of Congo was infected, the French health ministry said. The authorities said the risk to the wider population was low.

emojis.label: venezuela earthquake updates
emojis.title: Venezuela Live Updates: Death Toll Rises as Rescuers Mount Frantic Search for Survivors of Twin Earthquakes
emojis.summary: The 7.2- and 7.5-magnitude earthquakes left at least 164 dead and hundreds missing, the authorities said, but the full scale of the damage was not immediately clear.

emojis.label: public protest over puppy abuse in china
emojis.title: A Puppy-Abuse Case in China, Caught on Video, Prompts Rare Public Protest
emojis.summary: After a man was filmed torturing dogs, hundreds gathered in a rare demonstration that the police tried to break up. For many, the sit-in was their first civic action.

emojis.label: spain warns of high heat wave death toll
emojis.title: Live Updates: Spain Warns of High Death Toll in Heat Wave
emojis.summary: The health ministry said about 200 people may have died since Sunday. The forecast across Europe was set to remain sharply above normal on Thursday.
